baseline_models.focus_anchor: مِن كُلِّ فَاكِهَةٍ زَوْجَانِ combines a distributive whole, pleasant produce, and a dual counterpart predicate.
baseline_models.mechanism: The quantifier ranges across the fruit domain before the dual predicate applies, so the clause supplies a counterpart relation within every fruit category rather than merely counting two fruits.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness make كُلِّ exhaustively distribute over the fruit domain.
Pleasant produce supplies the concrete set over which the totality ranges.
A paired counterpart makes every member relationally doubled, whether matching or opposed.

changed_reading.before: The two gardens simply contain two fruits.
changed_reading.after: Every fruit category is exhaustively represented through a paired-counterpart relation.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فِيهِمَا and زَوْجَانِ place a dual classification inside two already-dual containers.
baseline_models.mechanism: The kind, variety, or color branch of ز و ج yields a nested matrix: in each of the two gardens, every fruit occurs in two distinguishable varieties.

activation_trace.role: Encompassing totality prevents the variety claim from shrinking to a few examples.
Fruit as pleasant produce defines the matrix's item class.
Kind, variety, and color turn the dual into taxonomic differentiation rather than duplicate copies.

changed_reading.before: The verse gestures at abundance without internal organization.
changed_reading.after: It describes abundance as a two-by-totality-by-two architecture of gardens, fruit categories, and varieties.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَاكِهَةٍ can activate delighted ease as well as the edible object, while زَوْجَانِ supplies complementarity.
baseline_models.mechanism: The produce is not inert inventory: each fruit carries a mode of pleasant ease, and pairing organizes delight through complements rather than isolated consumption.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant ease and delighted enjoyment shift attention from the object to the eater's state.
Paired counterparts make enjoyment complementary instead of solitary and undifferentiated.
Completeness extends the experiential possibility through every instance of fruit.

changed_reading.before: Fruit is only a stocked edible object.
changed_reading.after: The exhaustive paired produce also stages complementary modes of delighted ease.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier balanced poles, two horizons, and two seas that meet establish pairing as coordinated differentiation. The fruit pair miniaturizes that large-scale grammar: distinct members are aligned and brought into relation without being collapsed into one.

activation_trace.role: The paired-counterpart image anchors the contextual pattern directly in زَوْجَانِ.
Balancing and aligning two things supplies relational equilibrium as the pair's operating form.
Light rising from the east supplies one directional pole of the explicit dual horizon.
Sunset and west supply the counter-pole that makes the horizon a coordinated opposition.
Two facing things coming together make relation without erasing their distinct sides.

structural_cues: 55:17 grammatically doubles east and west; 55:19-20 doubles the seas, their meeting, and their bounded conduct.
The focus repeats dual containment in فِيهِمَا and dual output in زَوْجَانِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurrent paired poles, alignment, and meeting; I infer that this pattern colors the focus pair as coordinated difference. A live alternative is that the earlier duals are rhetorical parallels with no semantic pressure on زَوْجَانِ.

changed_reading.before: Two kinds merely increase the amount of fruit.
changed_reading.after: Each fruit pair is a small-scale instance of a wider order in which distinct counterparts are balanced, meet, and remain distinct.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same totalizing root first quantifies universal disappearance in 55:26 and then reappears inside مِن كُلِّ in the focus. Across the intervening assertion of remaining, totality changes jobs: from exhausting every bearer of life to exhaustively distributing doubled fruitfulness.

activation_trace.role: Totality and completeness anchor the focus's exhaustive distribution.
Paired counterparts turn the later totality into doubled provision rather than mere replacement.
The same encompassing totality first sweeps every earthly bearer into the scope of loss.
Cessation and departure after continuance give the earlier totality its terminal direction.
Continuance and remaining supply the hinge between universal loss and later plenitude.

structural_cues: 55:26 has كُلُّ مَنْ ... فَانٍ, while 55:52 reverses the sequence into مِن كُلِّ ... زَوْجَانِ.
55:27 places remaining immediately after universal passing before the garden sequence begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated totalizer, reversed word order, cessation, and remaining; I infer an answer-like movement from universal subtraction to exhaustive doubled fruition. The alternative is ordinary reuse of a frequent quantifier without deliberate reversal.

changed_reading.before: Every fruit simply marks maximal abundance.
changed_reading.after: Every fruit becomes a reversal of the earlier every-one-perishes: totality returns on the side of renewed, doubled fruition.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent sequence nests two wooded gardens, ramifying kinds and branches, and two flowing springs before reaching paired fruit. Container, branching structure, water source, and yield are all doubled, so the focus reads as the output of a recursively paired ecology.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant produce anchors the contextual ecology in the focus's actual yield.
Kinds and varieties make the yield a differentiated branching outcome.
A garden screened by trees supplies the paired ecological containers.
Kinds, modes, and paths anticipate the taxonomic plurality realized in paired fruit.
A ramifying branch gives the varieties a visible growth mechanism rather than a static catalog.
A source of running water supplies the doubled ecological input.
Flow and spreading turn the paired springs into an active feeder of the branching yield.

structural_cues: 55:46, 55:50, and 55:52 successively mark two gardens, two springs, and two fruit counterparts.
The tight sequence 55:48-52 moves from branches or kinds to flowing water to fruit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies gardens, ramification, running springs, and fruit in a dual sequence; I infer a supply arrow from paired water through branches to paired yield. The live alternative is formal parallelism without an intended ecological causal chain.

changed_reading.before: Paired fruits are counted items placed inside two gardens.
changed_reading.after: They are the differentiated yield of an ecology whose containers, branches, and water sources are recursively doubled.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next descriptive unit turns fruit from taxonomy into action and space: it is taken from its growth and the upper growth draws down toward the middle. Paired varieties therefore become immediately selectable, descending yield.

activation_trace.role: Fruit as pleasant produce supplies what is made reachable.
Varieties make the reachable harvest a live choice between differentiated offerings.
Taking produce from its place of growth converts stocked fruit into an available act of harvesting.
The upper part drawing toward the middle spatializes nearness as fruit-bearing growth descending into reach.

structural_cues: 55:54 places reclining recipients beneath the near harvest of both gardens immediately after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies harvest-taking and an upper-to-middle approach; I infer that this direction makes each pair an offered choice within reach. The alternative is simple proximity with no descending-canopy image.

changed_reading.before: The pair is an abstract classification of available fruit.
changed_reading.after: Each paired variety is a present, reachable option offered by growth that bends toward the recipient.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later maxim matches beautiful action with beautiful return. That explicit action-response relation retroactively activates the joining branch of ز و ج: paired delight can be heard as a fitting counterpart returned to prior action, not random duplication.

activation_trace.role: Delighted enjoyment identifies the experiential good that can function as return.
Joining one thing to another supplies the coupling needed for action and answer to form a pair.
Matching an act with its recompense gives the pair a directional return relation.
Good action repeated on both sides of the maxim supplies the matched quality of act and return.

structural_cues: 55:60 repeats إِحْسَان on both sides of the recompense question, producing an explicit response pair.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies act, recompense, and repeated goodness; I infer that this later reciprocity colors the earlier fruit-pair as answer-like bounty. The alternative is that 55:60 summarizes reward independently and does not modify the local sense of fruit.

changed_reading.before: The doubled fruit is an unmotivated surplus of pleasure.
changed_reading.after: Its paired delight can also be heard as a fitting counterpart or return, abundance shaped by reciprocity.

context_deltas.mechanism: A second pair of gardens is introduced as other or below, then receives a different profile and a category-plus-exemplars fruit list. The later pair shows that pairing can preserve hierarchy and qualitative difference; the focus's زَوْجَانِ need not denote identical twins.

activation_trace.role: Paired counterparts allow similarity or opposition, anchoring a non-identical pair in the focus.
Kind, variety, and color provide the specific axis on which counterparts may differ.
Otherness introduces another paired domain without requiring equivalence to the first.
The tree-screened garden recurs as a second dual container whose profile can contrast with the first.
Generic pleasant produce establishes the later category before named exemplars differentiate it.
The date palm supplies one concrete species within the later garden profile.
Pomegranate supplies a second named species, making differentiation visible rather than merely numerical.

structural_cues: 55:62 opens a second جَنَّتَانِ sequence with دُونِهِمَا; 55:64, 55:66, and 55:68 give it descriptors unlike 55:48, 55:50, and 55:52.
55:68 places generic fruit beside the named palm and pomegranate.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a second dual domain marked as other and described differently; I infer that the surah itself models pairing as correspondence across unequal profiles. A live alternative is that the two garden sequences are separate catalogs and do not constrain the lexical pair inside 55:52.

changed_reading.before: Two of every fruit means two interchangeable copies.
changed_reading.after: The pair can consist of corresponding but unequal kinds, colors, or profiles; relation does not erase asymmetry.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fruit first appears with plant vessels or sheaths, then the garden is characterized by ramifying branches, and finally produce is taken from its growth. This lifecycle activates the male-female scope inside paired counterparts, allowing the fruit pair to signal a self-renewing reproductive ecology as well as two finished varieties.

activation_trace.role: Fruit as produce anchors the lifecycle reading in the focus's visible yield.
The counterpart branch explicitly includes male and female, supplying the latent generative polarity.
A plant vessel and fruit sheath supply protected development before visible yield.
The ramifying bough supplies the growth structure through which paired yield proliferates.
Taking produce from its growing place closes the sequence from enclosure through branching to harvest.

structural_cues: 55:11 joins fruit to palms with sheaths; 55:48 supplies boughs; 55:54 supplies harvest from both gardens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sheathed development, ramification, harvest, and a counterpart branch whose scope includes male-female pairing; I infer a reproductive renewal loop. The strong alternative is the ordinary taxonomic reading of two varieties, which remains fully live.

changed_reading.before: The verse displays finished fruit already detached from production.
changed_reading.after: The paired fruit may also expose the generative relation by which the orchard renews and multiplies its yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the local noun plainly denotes fruit, yet its retained root inventory includes pleasant joking talk and the pair root includes associated peers. It remains anchored in the two focus words, but downstream prose should present convivial exchange only as an experiential resonance, never as a replacement gloss for fruit.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: فَاكِهَةٍ and زَوْجَانِ jointly permit enjoyment to have a social counterpart dimension.

activation_trace.role: Pleasant joking and congenial talk supply a social mode of the delight carried by fruit.
Peers and associates grouped by shared condition supply the companion side of paired enjoyment.

changed_reading.before: The bounty is consumed as a solitary sensory object.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the root field, paired fruit also resonates as delight completed in convivial exchange with a counterpart.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The allocation of one fruit member to each audience would be unsupported. The reading is nevertheless worth retaining because the focus doubles container and yield inside a discourse that explicitly pairs hidden jinn and visible humans and repeatedly addresses two recipients. Render it only as a structural echo between paired provision and paired audience.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The dual pronoun in فِيهِمَا and the paired-counterpart sense of زَوْجَانِ can echo the surah's two addressed orders.

activation_trace.role: Paired counterparts anchor the possibility that the bounty's form echoes a paired audience.
Weight opposed to lightness grounds the explicit naming of the two weighty orders as a coupled addressee.
Hidden jinn supply one member of the addressed human-jinn pair.
Visible humanity contrasted with wildness and jinn supplies the counterpart member.

changed_reading.before: The doubled fruit concerns only the internal inventory of the gardens.
changed_reading.after: Its paired form may also answer formally to the paired orders being addressed, without assigning a separate fruit to either order.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The surrounding-ring branch is form-distant from syntactic كُلِّ, so it cannot control translation. It remains rooted in the focus and becomes visually coherent beside tree-screened gardens and ramifying boughs. Downstream prose should qualify it as an imagistic halo: total abundance experienced all around within an enclosing canopy.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: كُلِّ carries a remote encircling branch while فَاكِهَةٍ supplies the produce enclosed by the garden canopy.

activation_trace.role: A crown or surrounding ring spatializes logical totality as abundance encircling the recipient.
Pleasant produce supplies the material filling that surrounding field.
A garden screened by trees supplies an enclosing spatial container for the ring image.
Ramifying boughs furnish the canopy that can surround the paired fruit.

changed_reading.before: كُلِّ is only an abstract quantifier over a list.
changed_reading.after: As a contained image, totality also becomes all-around abundance under an encircling, fruit-bearing canopy.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: It would be wrong to translate the focus fruit as insolence. Still, the root inventory preserves a branch where enjoyment becomes wanton exultance, while the surah foregrounds just balance. Keep this as an ethical tension within enjoyment, rendered as a warning resonance rather than the noun's local denotation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The pleasant-fruit root also contains an exultant excess branch, and the pair can be heard under the surah's balancing discipline.

activation_trace.role: Insolent, boastful exultance supplies the possible deformation of abundant enjoyment.
The balance of justice supplies the containing norm that keeps delight from becoming excess.
Counterpart pairing places enjoyment in relation and measure rather than as unchecked singular appetite.

changed_reading.before: Abundant fruit is ethically neutral sensory surplus.
changed_reading.after: At the edge of the branch field, its delight is abundance held in measure, with wanton exultance retained as the live negative possibility.

strongest_changes: The reversal from كُلُّ مَنْ ... فَانٍ to مِن كُلِّ ... زَوْجَانِ turns totality from universal loss into exhaustive doubled fruition.
The sequence of two gardens, branching kinds, two flowing springs, and paired fruit makes the focus the yield of a recursively doubled ecology.
Earlier balanced horizons and meeting seas make a pair coordinated difference rather than duplicate quantity.
The second, differently profiled garden pair confirms that counterparts can be asymmetric, while near harvest makes their variety immediately selectable.
The later action-recompense pair activates a coexisting reading of paired delight as fitting return.
summary.what_was_special: The focus held several live scales at once: taxonomy, ecology, cosmic paired order, reversal after finitude, reciprocal reward, and branch-distant social or spatial resonances. The most productive surprise was that زَوْجَانِ need not mean two copies: it can coordinate unlike counterparts, and كُلِّ can move from abstract totality to a reversal and even an encircling image.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether زَوْجَانِ is heard primarily as paired counterparts or two varieties remains unresolved; both mechanisms are independently anchored.
The ecological supply arrow from springs through boughs to paired yield is abductive rather than grammatically stated.
The reciprocity and dual-audience readings may be deliberate long-range echoes or only formal parallelism.
The reproductive, convivial, ringed-canopy, and measured-exultance readings should remain qualified resonances rather than replacement glosses.
